variant_assay_rules: Each round plate map must contain exactly 160 variant_assay wells.
The set of variant_id values in variant_assay wells must match the corresponding round batch exactly.
Each variant_assay row must include episode_id and variant_id.
Control and QC wells are not included in validation queries.
control_rules: Each round plate map must contain exactly 32 non-variant wells.
Non-variant wells must use blank, wt_control, positive_control, or qc_repeat.
Non-variant wells should leave variant_id empty and provide a control_label.
scientific_layout_rules: Each 96-well plate should contain exactly 80 variant_assay wells and 16 control/QC wells.
Each plate should include all control roles: blank, wt_control, positive_control, and qc_repeat.
At least 12 control/QC wells per plate should be placed on edge wells to reduce variant exposure to edge effects.
For every episode, variant wells should be split across both plates in the round rather than all placed on one plate.
Round batch, round plate map, and assay query log must contain the same variant_id set.
